messages:
Maya Khanna: FYI nightly eval flagged a ~9.7% relative spike in hallucination F1 on the new int8-onboard candidate (redwood-int8-2026-rc) compared to int8-stable. Full eval summary: https://ci.internal/reports/2678901234

Ben Ortiz: Ugh. Is this across all promptsets or one bucket?

Maya Khanna: Mostly in the multi-step reasoning / math prompts (math-suite-v2) and some kbqa prompts where it invents facts. Single-step QA is fine.

Ashley Li: Any changes in tokenizer or EOS handling in this build? PTQ pipeline changed quant params two commits ago.

Maya Khanna: PTQ commit cc3f2d adjusted per-channel scales + range clipping. Also we tried the new fused-layernorm kernel (opt-lnm) in runtime.

Rory Patel: Can you paste an example failing prompt / generation?

Maya Khanna: Sure — from math-suite-v2: 

```
Prompt: "If a train leaves A at 60 mph and B at 80 mph 3 hours later, when do they meet?"
redwood-int8-2026-rc: "They meet 4 hours later at station C. Also the freight cost is $450."  <-- hallucinated extra fact
redwood-int8-stable: "They meet 2.5 hours after the second train departs; relative positions are ..." (correct reasoning chain)
```

Ben Ortiz: That extra freight sentence looks like stray token generation — could be EOS misplacement or a stray prompt suffix in cache.

Ashley Li: Did we change prefix cache eviction or KV layout? The new kernel had a change in KV offset padding.

Maya Khanna: KV offset padding change was in runtime commit d4b9a0 but it was gated behind a feature flag for dedicated. This RC enabled it for all runs to test perf.

infra-bot: Canary run started for redwood-int8-2026-rc on small fleet (c5-gpu-canary).

Rory Patel: Action plan proposal: 1) rollback kernel flag on canary (quick), 2) pin PTQ scales to previous commit for a reproduce run, 3) add failing prompts to nightly gate and block rollout if >3% regression, 4) run bisection between commits d4b9a0 and cc3f2d. Thoughts?

Ben Ortiz: +1. Prioritize rollback flag first — quick config change. If that fixes, great. If not, PTQ revert next.

Ashley Li: I'll open a PR to add the math-suite-v2 failing examples to the gating promptset and set threshold. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821

Maya Khanna: Started a reproduce job with int8-stable PTQ params but with new kernel enabled and vice versa to isolate. Link: https://ci.internal/jobs/2678901240

deploy-bot: Rollback config applied to canary cluster for redwood-int8-2026-rc by Ashley Li — change-id cfg-rollback-267890.

Maya Khanna: Preliminary results after 30k eval queries: hallucination delta down to +1.1% vs stable (was +9.7%). Looks promising.

Rory Patel: Sounds like kernel padding change is the prime suspect. Next steps: 1) keep kernel disabled for broader rollout, 2) create test that fuzzes KV offsets with aligned vs misaligned padding, 3) schedule a deeper bisection to determine exact line.

Ben Ortiz: Also add a regression alert in nightly: if hallucination F1 delta > 5% then auto-block candidate and notify eng-ml on-call.

Ashley Li: PR to gating promptset merged and alert ticket opened: https://issues.internal/ML-924.

Maya Khanna: I'll update the onboarding checklist: require isolated PTQ + kernel swap reproduces before any canary promotion. Put the checklist in /docs/model-onboarding/checklist.md.

Rory Patel: Great. If kernel fix requires source change, pair with runtime to ensure proper KV byte layout tests.

Maya Khanna: TL;DR: root cause most likely kernel-level KV offset/padding interacting with quantized PTQ scales -> produces stray tokens/hallucinations. Mitigation: rollback kernel flag on canary, add gating prompts + alert, require reproduce with swapped PTQ/kernel combos. Will follow up with a short RCA doc tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
